title: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) Readings
summary: Sub-minute interstitial glucose levels from wearable biosensors; produced by patients, controlled by device makers (Dexcom, Abbott) and insurers.

title: Seismic Sensor Arrays Around Nuclear Test Sites (CTBTO IMS)
summary: Ground motion data from IMS hydroacoustic and seismic stations operated by the CTBTO; nominally open but raw waveforms are restricted.

title: Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) Location Logs
summary: Time-stamped plate reads from fixed and mobile cameras; controlled by police departments, Motorola, and Vigilant Solutions.

title: Satellite Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Imagery of Industrial Sites
summary: All-weather radar backscatter revealing building activity, vehicle counts, and equipment changes; produced by Sentinel-1, ICEYE, and Capella Space.

title: Ambient Air Quality Sensor Networks (Low-Cost)
summary: PM2.5, ozone, and NO₂ readings from consumer-grade sensors like PurpleAir; controlled by property owners and partially aggregated by EPA AirNow.

title: Subsurface Soil Moisture from SMAP Satellite
summary: Passive microwave brightness temperature converted to volumetric water content; produced by NASA and publicly archived.

title: Traffic Induction Loop Counts on Highway Networks
summary: Vehicle counts and speeds from buried road sensors; controlled by state DOTs and INRIX.

title: Utility Smart Meter Power Consumption (15-Minute Intervals)
summary: Household-level electricity draw; controlled by utilities (PG&E, EDF) and smart meter vendors (Itron, Landis+Gyr).

title: Passive Acoustic Hydrophone Recordings in Ocean Basins
summary: Ambient ocean sound capturing whale vocalizations, ship noise, and seismic events; operated by NOAA and SOSUS legacy infrastructure.

title: Aerial LiDAR Surveys of Urban Tree Canopy
summary: Point cloud elevation data revealing tree height, density, and species distribution; conducted by municipalities and USGS.

title: Industrial Stack Emissions CEMS Data
summary: Continuous emissions monitoring measuring SO₂, NOₓ, and CO₂ from power plants; reported to EPA under the Clean Air Act, partially public.

title: Body-Worn Camera Footage from Police Departments
summary: Video and audio of police interactions; controlled by police departments and Axon, with retention policies that vary widely.

title: Electromagnetic Field (EMF) Readings Near High-Voltage Transmission Lines
summary: Magnetic flux density logged by utility and independent monitors; rarely published systematically.

title: Accelerometer Data from Smartphones During Driving
summary: G-force, braking, and cornering profiles captured passively by apps like Google Maps and insurance telematics.

title: Ground-Penetrating Radar Surveys of Archaeological Sites
summary: Subsurface anomaly maps produced before construction; controlled by developers and often not archived publicly.

title: River Gauge Water Level and Flow (USGS Stream Network)
summary: Real-time stage and discharge from ~8,000 US gauges; publicly available via USGS Water Resources.

title: Thermal Infrared Satellite Imagery of Urban Heat Islands
summary: Land surface temperature from Landsat and ECOSTRESS; public but underused by city planners.

title: Radiation Dosimetry Logs from Nuclear Plant Workers
summary: Individual cumulative exposure badges; controlled by plant operators and the NRC, with limited public aggregation.

title: Wildlife Camera Trap Images in Protected Areas
summary: Triggered photos of animals at GPS-tagged locations; controlled by NGOs, park services, and research universities.

title: Indoor CO₂ Concentration in School Classrooms
summary: Ventilation proxy from NDIR sensors; rarely mandated or archived, with some voluntary programs existing.

title: Ocean Buoy Sea Surface Temperature and Salinity (Argo Floats)
summary: Depth-resolved temperature and salinity profiles from 4,000 autonomous floats; publicly available via Coriolis and GDAC.

title: Aircraft ADS-B Transponder Position Broadcasts
summary: Real-time GPS position, altitude, and speed from commercial and private aircraft; aggregated by FlightAware and the OpenSky Network.

title: Acoustic Gunshot Detection Network Logs (ShotSpotter)
summary: Classified microphone array recordings and shot location inferences; controlled by SoundThinking and shared selectively with police.

title: Satellite Nighttime Light Intensity (VIIRS DNBS)
summary: Radiance images revealing economic activity, outages, and conflict zones; produced by NOAA and publicly archived.

title: Rainwater Chemistry from Acid Deposition Monitoring (NADP)
summary: pH, sulfate, and nitrate in precipitation from the NADP network; public but underfunded.

title: Microscopy Images from Automated Pathology Slide Scanners
summary: Whole-slide images from hospital pathology labs; controlled by hospital systems and vendors (Philips, Leica).

title: Glacier Mass Balance from Laser Altimetry (ICESat-2)
summary: Ice surface height change at meter scale; produced by NASA and publicly archived.

title: Vehicle OBD-II Diagnostic Port Telemetry
summary: Engine codes, RPM, and fuel trim from onboard diagnostics; accessed by automakers, insurers, and third-party dongles.

title: Passive Radon Monitoring in Residential Buildings
summary: Alpha particle track density in charcoal canisters; conducted by homeowners and EPA programs, rarely systematic.

title: Automated Weather Station Data from Agricultural Fields
summary: Soil temperature, humidity, and wind at crop-level resolution; controlled by farm management platforms (Climate Corporation, Trimble).

title: Infrared Spectroscopy Readings of Soil Samples
summary: Organic carbon and nutrient content from hyperspectral sensors; controlled by agrochemical companies and research labs.

title: Passive Water Quality Sensors in Municipal Distribution Networks
summary: Chlorine residual, turbidity, and conductivity at inline probes; controlled by water utilities and rarely public.

title: Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) Logs from Cargo Ships
summary: Roll, pitch, heading, and vibration from vessel monitoring systems; controlled by shipping companies and insurers.

title: Drone Aerial Imagery of Construction Sites
summary: Photogrammetry point clouds and orthomosaics; controlled by construction firms and drone service companies.

title: Cryosphere Permafrost Temperature Borehole Data
summary: Ground temperature at depth from Arctic monitoring stations; operated by GTN-P, partially public but sparse.

title: Hospital HVAC and Patient Room Environmental Sensors
summary: Temperature, humidity, and airflow in clinical spaces; controlled by hospital facilities and not systematically archived.

title: Passive Network Traffic Probes at Internet Exchange Points
summary: Aggregate flow statistics (NetFlow/IPFIX) at major IXPs; controlled by IXP operators (LINX, AMS-IX) and not public.

title: Hyperspectral Satellite Imagery of Agricultural Fields
summary: Crop stress, chlorophyll, and moisture from Planet and HyperScout; controlled by satellite operators and agrochemical buyers.

title: Fetal Heart Rate Monitor Tracings (Cardiotocography)
summary: Continuous fetal HR and uterine contraction records during labor; controlled by hospitals and rarely digitized or archived.

title: Automated Fish Stock Acoustic Surveys (Fisheries Sonar)
summary: Hydroacoustic backscatter of fish biomass from research vessels; controlled by NOAA Fisheries and partially public.

title: Industrial Vibration Sensors on Rotating Machinery
summary: Bearing wear and imbalance signatures from predictive maintenance systems; controlled by manufacturers (Siemens, GE).

title: Retail Shelf Sensor Weight and Presence Data
summary: Stock-level inference from pressure pads or weight cells; controlled by retailers and shelf-monitoring vendors.

title: Groundwater Level Readings from Municipal Monitoring Wells
summary: Aquifer depth from transducers; operated by water districts and USGS, variably public.

title: Neonatal ICU (NICU) Physiological Waveforms
summary: Continuous HR, SpO₂, and respiratory rate at 125 Hz; controlled by hospital EHR systems and rarely archived at full resolution.

title: Coastal Wetland Elevation from Tidal Gauges
summary: Marsh surface elevation relative to datum; operated by USGS ECOMAP and underutilized for sea level planning.

title: Satellite Ocean Color Imagery (Chlorophyll Concentration)
summary: Phytoplankton biomass proxy from MODIS and PACE; publicly available via NASA Ocean Color.

title: Air Traffic Control Radar Returns
summary: Primary and secondary surveillance radar reflections of all aircraft; controlled by FAA and Eurocontrol, not public beyond ADS-B.

title: Biometric Access Control Logs (Fingerprint/Iris Readers)
summary: Entry/exit timestamps linked to biometric identifiers; controlled by employers and building management firms.

title: Atmospheric Methane Point-Source Plumes (GHGSat)
summary: High-resolution CH₄ concentration above oil and gas facilities; controlled by GHGSat and sold to operators and regulators.
